Definition: of uncertain affinity; the chest ("thorax"), i.e. (by implication) a corslet:--breast-plate.
BiblicalUsage: thṓrax is the Bible's word for a breastplate. In Ephesians 6:14, having on the breastplate of righteousness, and it appears again in 1 Thessalonians 5:8.
TheologicalSignificance: A breastplate of righteousness buckled on for battle makes me want righteousness guarding my heart before I face the day.
